npcs.name: Odessa Quill
npcs.title: Master Artisan

lines: A ferry at the dock again! I knew those clever hands of yours would get us there.
Listen to that fountain sing. I had forgotten the square could sound like this.
The whole village is talking about your bridge, {name}. Mostly Fern. Loudly.
Ah, {name}! Mind the loose cobbles — and the loose ends. This village is full of both.
Good to see you, apprentice. Has the Starforge Tool been behaving?

sleepy: Mm? Oh, {name}… I was just resting my eyes. For an hour or six.

topics.label: What is the Starforge Tool?
lines: Long ago, Wonderhaven's artisans shaped the islands with tools like that one.
It turns ordinary wood and stone into whatever your heart can picture — powered by Spark Energy.
Gather Spark from the world, and the world gives you back a little magic. That is the whole trick, really.

topics.label: What happened to Wonderhaven?
lines: The old magic went quiet. Not broken — sleepy, like a cat in the sun.
Bridges sagged, workshops gathered dust, and the ferries stopped coming.
Every bit of kindness you build wakes a little more of it. We call that Harmony.

topics.label: Any building tips?
lines: Press B to call up your Starforge grid. Green means yes, red means "try somewhere else".
R turns a piece, T changes its colour, and if you make a mess — Ctrl+Z. Even masters need it.

topics.label: Tell me about the other isles.
lines: Clockwork Cove, full of gears and gadgets. Blooming Wilds, where the flowers are taller than houses.
Starlight Shores and its harbor markets, and Moonveil Hollow, where the mushrooms glow.
Once our harbor opens, you will see them for yourself.

gifts.line: Here — the window design from my own first cottage. Let the light in, {name}.

npcs.name: Fern Marigold
npcs.title: Village Gardener

lines: The apple trees say hello! Well. They rustled. I'm choosing to believe it was hello.
Shh — I'm telling the tulips a story. They get nervous without one.
Oh! {name}! The daisies were just asking about you.

sleepy: Zzz… no, carrots, you can't stay up late… oh! Hello.

topics.label: Do plants really talk?
lines: Of course! They just talk very, very slowly.
A sunflower once told me a joke. I'll let you know the punchline next spring.

topics.label: What's across the river?
lines: My orchard! Apple trees, a secret seed shed, and the best picnic spot in the kingdom.
I haven't been able to visit since the old bridge fell in. The trees must be so lonely.

topics.label: How does gardening work?
lines: Plant a seed in one of my garden beds, give it water, and wait.
Water it again whenever the soil looks thirsty. In a little while — blooms!

gifts.line: For my favourite builder: special seeds. Plant them somewhere they can see the sky!

npcs.name: Bram Shavings
npcs.title: Carpenter

lines: I made a chair with a built-in teapot today. Don't tell anyone. Actually… do tell people.
Oh — h-hello. Sorry. I was practising saying hello. That went… fine?
The workshop is all dust and boxes. A carpenter without a workshop is just a person who owns a lot of sawdust.

sleepy: *yawn* I dreamt of a sofa shaped like a swan. It was beautiful.

topics.label: What do you love to make?
lines: Officially? Sensible chairs. Sturdy tables.
Secretly…
A chandelier shaped like a whale. A bed with a slide. A bookshelf that hugs you.
Please forget I said all of that.

topics.label: What happened to the workshop?
lines: It's been shut for years. Everything inside is either broken, dusty, or broken AND dusty.
If someone could help me set it up again… I'd need a workbench, a chair, a lamp and some shelves.

gifts.line: I drew this sofa for you. It's… extra fluffy. On purpose.

npcs.name: King Percival Puffington
npcs.title: King of Hearthglow

lines: The harbor stands open! I have written fourteen proclamations about it. Fifteen, if you count the limerick.
Hark! A citizen approaches! State your business — unless it is alarming, in which case state it calmly.
Disaster, {name}! Utter disaster! …Someone has left a slightly crooked flowerpot by the castle gate.

sleepy: I am not sleeping. I am conducting a very long, very quiet emergency meeting.

topics.label: Is the castle really yours?
lines: Every turret and teaspoon of it! King Percival the First, at your service. And the only, so far.
The magic dozed off, the courtiers wandered away, and now it is just me, a very long table and a great deal of dusting.

topics.label: Why is the harbor sealed?
lines: Royal Decree Number Forty-Seven! Issued when the magic faded and the boats stopped coming.
It may only be lifted when the kingdom is in Harmony again. One hundred and twenty Harmony, to be precise. I counted.

topics.label: Any emergencies today?
lines: A pigeon looked at me sideways this morning. I have convened a committee.
The committee is me. I am taking it very seriously.

gifts.line: A statue design, for heroic citizens. You may model it on yourself. I would.

npcs.name: Tilly Sprocket
npcs.title: Inventor

lines: Look at it GO! Pumps pumping, pipes piping — honestly my best work, and I barely did any of it!
Careful! That pile of bolts is load-bearing. Emotionally.
Oh good, a person! Hold this. No — the other this. Thank you!

sleepy: Zzz… needs more gears… zzz… FEWER gears… zzz…

topics.label: Where are you from?
lines: Clockwork Cove! Island of windmills, waterwheels and things that go "ping".
My caravan rolled off the last ferry before the harbor closed. I've been inventing here ever since.

topics.label: How do machines work here?
lines: Easy! Something makes power — a waterwheel in a stream, or a windmill in the breeze.
Shafts and gear boxes carry it. A powered pump next to water pushes water through pipes.
Line up the connectors! A pipe only talks to a pipe it's actually pointing at.

topics.label: What are you inventing?
lines: A self-buttering toaster. It is currently buttering everything except toast.
Also the ceiling. Don't look at the ceiling.

gifts.line: Spare parts! Some of them were even spare on purpose.

npcs.name: Mabel Crumb
npcs.title: Baker

lines: The ovens are warm and the scones are squirrel-free! Mostly. One scone has a tiny bite out of it. I'm calling it "rustic".
Shoo! Shoo! Oh — not you, dear. The squirrels. They've taken over my bakery!
Welcome to Crumb & Co.! We are currently closed due to… fluffy circumstances.

sleepy: Mm… the dough needs to rise… and so do I… in eight hours.

topics.label: Squirrels?
lines: Three of them! They smell my acorn scones and simply move in.
They're not mean, just very, very hungry and very, very confident.

topics.label: What do you bake?
lines: Cloudberry buns, honey twists, and my famous Starlight Scones.
The secret ingredient is a pinch of Spark Energy. Don't tell Percival; he'll want a royal recipe hearing.

gifts.line: A warm Starlight Scone! Eat it while it sparkles.

lines: She's seaworthy and itching to sail! Climb aboard whenever you like, matey.
Ahoy! Did I ever tell you about the time I sailed through a storm made entirely of jellybeans?
The sea, {name}! Vast! Blue! Occasionally pink, near Moonveil, but don't ask.

topics.label: Tell me a sea story.
lines: Once I wrestled a squid the size of a lighthouse. Or a lighthouse the size of a squid. It was foggy.
Either way, we're friends now. He sends a card every winter.

topics.label: Where can the ferry go?
lines: Every island in Wonderhaven, once their docks are fixed up!
Clockwork Cove is nearest. You'll hear it before you see it — all those gears going clank.
